description: This is an HTML source file implementing a web-based database visualizer interface with embedded CSS and JavaScript functionalities for fetching, displaying, and interacting with database and table data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database's table list, and loads tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads data for a selected table and displays it in a table format.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Creates HTML to display table data with support for wide content and expandable cells.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling nulls, objects, and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for wide or object data types.
